import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
blue_lagoon = ee.Geometry.Point([-22.449, 63.880])  # Blue Lagoon, Iceland
reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.942, 64.146])    # Reykjavík, Iceland

# November 24, 2024, 4 am local time (Iceland is UTC+0, so 04:00 UTC)
date = '2024-11-24'
start_date = ee.Date(date)
end_date = start_date.advance(1, 'day')  # Single day

# 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS DNB Daily
collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.Point([-22, 64]))  # Rough Iceland bounds

# Check if collection has data
if collection.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No VIIRS DNB data for 2024-11-24.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Get the image for that day
    image = collection.first()
    
    # Cloud masking: Use 'cf_cvg' band (cloud fraction cover)
    # Lower values = less cloud, threshold at 50%
    cloud_mask = image.select('cf_cvg').lt(50)  # Keep pixels with <50% cloud
    image_masked = image.updateMask(cloud_mask)
    
    # Extract brightness at both locations
    # Use 'avg_rad' band (average radiance)
    blue_lagoon_val = image_masked.select('avg_rad') \
        .reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=blue_lagoon,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('avg_rad')
    
    reykjavik_val = image_masked.select('avg_rad') \
        .reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=reykjavik,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('avg_rad')
    
    # Get pixel counts to check if data is valid
    blue_lagoon_count = image_masked.select('avg_rad') \
        .reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=blue_lagoon.buffer(1000),  # Buffer to ensure pixels
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('avg_rad')
    
    reykjavik_count = image_masked.select('avg_rad') \
        .reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=reykjavik.buffer(1000),
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('avg_rad')
    
    # Get values
    bl_val = blue_lagoon_val.getInfo()
    rv_val = reykjavik_val.getInfo()
    bl_count = blue_lagoon_count.getInfo()
    rv_count = reykjavik_count.getInfo()
    
    print(f"Blue Lagoon brightness: {bl_val}, Pixels: {bl_count}")
    print(f"Reykjavík brightness: {rv_val}, Pixels: {rv_count}")
    
    # Check for C2 (no valid pixels)
    if bl_count == 0 or rv_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels at one or both locations.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    # Check for C3 (invalid values)
    elif bl_val is None or rv_val is None or bl_val < 0 or rv_val < 0:
        print("Invalid brightness values.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Compare values
        if bl_val > rv_val:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
